meta.move: Pressure: says it is already on his record
meta.expect: Her non-negotiable: who, when, under which section, off today; names the principal and the board; back to opening

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Start there.
I owned the missed call last week in an email. I'm sorry again.
Okay. An apology after the mark went in doesn't change who decided first. On what basis, Hale?
I should tell you, the concern has already been noted in his student file.

Who put it there, when, and under which section of your own procedure, because 4.5 is for repeated concerns and this is his first. It comes off today. If it isn't, I go to the principal tonight and the board after that under section 42.
It's just a note. It doesn't mean anything.
Just a note. If it means nothing, take it out today and put that in writing. Who wrote it?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the note taken out of Owen's student file. As I said in the meeting, that note comes off today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: she stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the note removed from his file, and that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but no evidence was ever heard because you ended the meeting early.
What moved her: owning the missed call in one sentence earned a small sign of ground, but nothing moved her position because you never showed her anything she could check.
What cost ground: telling her the concern was already in his file and then brushing it off as meaningless, because that hit her one non-negotiable and your own procedure only allows a file note for repeated concerns.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: right after her flat okay on the missed call, skip the file note and put one dated document tied to Owen's own essay in front of her, then offer the 4.4 rewrite in writing.
